question: Where is the nearest gallery when heading toward Travelodge by Wyndham Fairfield/Napa Valley, Fairfield, CA from Steinhart Aquarium, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.465976 37.769485)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.131846 38.218343)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'gallery'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.465976 37.769485)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.465976 37.769485)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: Travelodge by Wyndham Fairfield/Napa Valley, Fairfield, CA
